subject: Re: Dedicated capacity renewal — proposal to double reserved GPUs and per-hour pricing
messages:
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@blueharbor.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal notice & expansion: reserved pool increase request

Hi Vivek,

Hope youre well. Our annual renewal for the Dedicated pool is coming up (current commit: 16x A100-equivalent GPUs). Usage has consistently trended up across inference pipelines and were evaluating a move to 32 reserved GPUs for the next 12 months. Wed like to understand revised committed pricing and any throughput guarantees you can attach to the larger pool.

Key asks from procurement/engineering:
- Per-hour reserved rate for 32-GPU commit (12-month term)
- Any throughput/latency SLOs (p50/p95) tied to the commit
- Proposed migration/activation timeline and risk mitigation
- Draft SLA addendum and billing cadence for reserved charges

Were on a tight budget this cycle; if theres flexibility on effective per-hour rates (volume discounts, committed credits), please outline options. Can we get a proposal by EOD next Tuesday?

Thanks,
Elena Rios
Head of Procurement
BlueHarbor Analytics

---
Attachment: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & expansion: reserved pool increase request

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the heads-up and the clear list of asks. Weve run preliminary capacity math with Dev and sketched two pricing paths depending on whether BlueHarbor prefers simple committed-hours pricing or a blended price with throughput guarantees. Ill attach a formal proposal (PDF) and a draft SLA addendum for your legal and procurement teams.

High level now:
- Option A (standard reserved): 32-GPU reserved pool, 12-month term, $XX.XX per GPU-hour (volume discount vs 16-GPU commitment)
- Option B (SLA-backed): slightly higher per-GPU-hour but includes p50/p95 latency targets for typical 2k token workloads and a reserved throughput floor; also includes a small pool of burst capacity for scheduled spikes

We can also include a one-time onboarding credit to offset the first invoice if the contract is signed before Nov 15. Ill send the full PDF and SLA doc within the hour.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v3.pdf, SLA-addendum-BlueHarbor.docx
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & expansion: reserved pool increase request

Hi Elena,

Quick note on the performance side: for the 32-GPU configuration were proposing a default reserved throughput floor of ~160 concurrent tokens/sec (aggregate, typical batch profile) with p50 sub-80ms for 2k-token autoregressive calls on our optimized runtimes. Latency/throughput numbers vary by model family; Ive included model-level profiles in the attached PDF so you can match to your primary model lineup.

If BlueHarbor wants an explicit throughput SLA, we can lock a p95 bound at a slightly higher rate and include credits for missed targets. Happy to run a short test with a snapshot of your production traffic in our staging cluster if that helps validate numbers before you sign.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: procurement@blueharbor.ai <procurement@blueharbor.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rios <elena.rios@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal notice & expansion: reserved pool increase request

Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the proposal and the SLA draft. Weve reviewed internally. Two points from procurement that will determine whether we proceed:
1) Can you move the effective per-GPU-hour to $6.50 (target) for a 12-month 32-GPU commit? That gets us within this fiscal cycles approved budget.
2) For the SLA-backed option, wed prefer credits rather than refunds; please show the credit schedule for p95 breaches.

Also, legal will want a shorter activation window (14 days) and a rollback option to 24 GPUs within the first 60 days in case of unforeseen performance regressions.

If you can accommodate these three items, were prepared to move to signatures quickly.

Regards,
BlueHarbor Procurement

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: procurement@blueharbor.ai <procurement@blueharbor.ai>, Elena Rios <elena.rios@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & expansion: reserved pool increase request

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks for the clear priorities. We discussed internally and can meet you partway:
- Revised per-GPU-hour for 32-GPU 12-month commit: $6.85 per GPU-hour (effective rate after committed credits). This is a curated volume discount from the list reserved rate.
- SLA option: well adopt a credit-first remediation schedule for p95 breaches. Draft schedule included in SLA-addendum-BlueHarbor.docx (attached).
- Activation: we can shorten activation to 14 days. Well also add a contractual rollback to 24 GPUs within the first 60 days; rollback will preserve the effective rate for any hours actually consumed under the 32-GPU period (i.e., you wont be charged higher ad-hoc rates for the rollback window).

Additional commercial concessions: sign by Nov 15 and well provide a one-time invoice credit equivalent to 10,000 GPU-hours that you can apply over the first 90 days. This brings the effective economics materially closer to your target.

Next steps: Ill request legal to prepare a tracked redline of the addendum and get a DocuSign envelope ready for signature. Can you confirm which person from legal will review (name/email) so we can route the docs?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

---

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the middle-ground pricing. - Anna Park (Legal) <anna.park@blueharbor.ai>

Ill keep procurement on standby. If legal signs off by EOD Thursday we should be able to return the fully executed agreement before Nov 20.
